configuration: Inherited local CLI model settings; no model or reasoning overrides.
design: 50 synthetic topics; 40 three-response briefings and 10 five-response briefings; 50 independent downstream executions; two independent grading passes.
context: Each CLI call is ephemeral. Later briefing turns receive only the exact prior user/assistant text for that case. Full portable specification is inline; no future persona facts or grading criteria are passed to improvers.
scope: Text outputs; no purchases, messages, deployment or physical operations. Live web is available when factual verification is needed. Closed supplied materials take precedence.
timing: Fixtures and topic-specific checks fixed before all runs. Shared scoring rubric saved before judging the three pilot cases and before starting the remaining 47 cases. No skill edits during audit.
skills_tested: Portable SPECIFICATION.md only in automated behavioral runs; modular routing assessed separately by static reviewer.
